have h_exp_pos_int := ht_int_pos
have h_exp_neg_int := ht_int_neg
let f := fun ω => Real.exp (|t| * |X ω|)
have h_f_nonneg : 0 ≤ᵐ[μ] f :=
  by intro ω; exact Real.exp_nonneg (|t| * |X ω|)
have h_f_bounded : ∃ M, f ≤ᵐ[μ] fun ω => M :=
  by refine ⟨Real.exp (|t| * Real.abs (Real.abs X))⟩;
    intro ω; exact Real.exp_le_exp (|t| * |X ω|) (|t| * Real.abs (Real.abs X))
have h_f_integrable : MeasureTheory.Integrable f μ :=
  by apply MeasureTheory.Integrable.integral_eq_integral_Ioc_meas_le;
    exact ⟨h_exp_pos_int, h_f_nonneg, h_f_bounded⟩
